name: Poker for Us
overview: Vitya, Egoy and Beck open a poker club at home to earn money quickly. Playing the bigwigs of the underground business seems funny to them at first. But the "funny thing" quickly ends when one of the clients demonstrates the crust of an OBEP employee and confronts the guys with the fact that they are now "partners", otherwise they will have to go to jail. Now they are forced to expand their illegal business, which is turning from a single poker table in an ordinary apartment building into an underground gaming empire.
